component.name: OSCAR
component.summary: The Open Source CPAP Analysis Reporter

description.p: OSCAR is PC software developed for reviewing and exploring data produced by CPAP and related machines used in the treatment of sleep apnea.
It is a derivative of SleepyHead and reads data from the SD cards of supported CPAP machines and oximeters, presenting detailed graphs, statistics and reports.

ul.li: Detailed daily graphs of pressure, flow, leaks, events and oximetry
Overview, statistics and printable reports across days, weeks and months
Data stored in a local SQLite database that other tools can query directly
Flexible CSV export and profile import/export

description.p: OSCAR is not a medical device and is not intended for diagnosis. Discuss your therapy data with your doctor.
New devices, oximetry improvements and many fixes.

ul.li: Headless command line data import, and a Windows portable mode
Support for the Löwenstein Prisma VENT 50-C (experimental) and Weinmann SOMNObalance e
SpO2 drops can use a rolling, whole night, first hour or fixed baseline, and oximetry data can be split to match the CPAP day split
Fixes in the ResMed oximetry, BMC, Löwenstein Prisma and Sefam S.Box loaders, duplicated respiratory events, Alt+Tab on Linux, and the per-profile Steady Breathing setting
Support for Yuwell YH-560, YH-920 and YH-480C, Sefam S.Box and Néa, Sanrai Reve Auto, BMC G3X E5 B25A Plus, and Apex Medical Apex XT (experimental)
Apple Health files and the Ukrainian language are now supported
Central and obstructive AHI are now reported
Clearer instructions on first use, and an option not to update the database schema
Many fixes in the ResMed, PRS1, BMC and Löwenstein loaders, CSV export, profile restore and translations

description.p: OSCAR 2.0 replaces all previous versions of OSCAR.

ul.li: Data is now stored in an SQLite database in a separate OSCAR20_Data folder
Existing OSCAR 1.x data can be converted on first start or imported per profile
New CSV export wizard and profile import/export
Support for the ResMed Sleepmate series and Yuwell YH-500/YH-580 CPAPs
SpO2 support in the BMC loader and a new SpO2 baseline calculation setting
Fixed flow size in the vREM loader
Russian and Traditional Chinese translation updates
Support for the vREM and BMC CPAPs
Improved Steady Breathing
Fixed crashes when importing into a new profile and when using a pop-out graph
Import dialog fixes and better handling of existing directories
Qt6 build support
Support for the Wellue/Viatom POD-2 with low battery warning
Search by apnea length, CSR/PB and large leaks
GUI for Steady Breathing, ALT+B to add a bookmark, and configurable Daily Notes font size
Fixed a crash in search and VPAPauto pressure graph colors
Support for the iBreeze 30ST/A, ResMed AirCurve 11 series and Viatom/Wellue O2Ring-S
Native file dialogs on Windows and an option to disable daily graph titles
Remembers the last used CSV export folder
Fixed several crashes, profile and unit conversion issues, and keyboard navigation with bookmarks
Daily search for any journal item (notes, bookmarks, weight, feelings)
Import (restore) journal and a configurable daily left sidebar
Fixed profiles without a name blocking access to data and statistics showing future dates
Profiles can now be renamed
Graph hints at the bottom of the Daily and Overview tabs
Statistics improvements, including alternating row colors
Fixed daylight saving time display issues, lost snore events and iBreeze loader problems
Added the DS Go Auto 500G150 model
Fixed high resolution display issues, with a new setting in Preferences > Appearance
Re-enabled biometrics and fixed update checking
Support for ResMed AirSense 11, Hoffrichter Point 3 and Resvent machines
Clinical and Permissive compliance modes
Search in the Daily screen, backup of graph settings and Shift+click zoom
Fixed high resolution display issues and improved PrismaLine bilevel support
Support for Philips Respironics DreamStation 2
More Philips Respironics devices tested and fully supported
Fixed pressure settings and events on BiPAP autoSV Advanced 30
Fixed session export statistics and a rare crash importing corrupted data
